rules.description:
▪ You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly Adeptus Astartes units’ ranged attacks that target a unit within 12”, have +1 S.


If your army includes a Vulkan He’stan unit, friendly Infernus Squad units have the following:
▪ When this unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move, that advance/fall-back move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
▪ When this unit starts an action, that action does not prevent this unit from being eligible to shoot.


Restrictions: Your army can include Salamanders units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Masters of Shadow
rules.description:
Friendly Adeptus Astartes units have Stealth.


Friendly Phobos/Scout Squad units have -3" detection range.


Friendly Aethon Shaan units have the following ability:


Unparalleled Tactician: (Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Into Darkness stratagem, that use is -1CP..

rules.name: Storm-Swift Onslaught
rules.description:
▪ You can select the assault doctrine or tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.
▪ Friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder units have +1 to advance rolls.
▪ Friendly Suboden Khan units have the following ability:


Wrath of the First Khan: At the end of the Fight phase, if this unit was eligible to fight this phase, you can use this ability. If you do:


▪ If this unit is unengaged, this unit can make a normal move.
▪ Or: If this unit is engaged, this unit can make a fall-back move.


Restrictions: Your army can include White Scars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Mastered Doctrines
rules.description: If your army includes a Marneus Calgar unit, you can select the assault doctrine/devastator doctrine/tactical doctrine each one additional time per battle.

rules.name: Master of Wolves
rules.description:
Friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES units (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLES units) with this ability have the following abilities:


Encircling Jaws: If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit has +1 to advance rolls and charge rolls.


Hunter’s Eye: If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s ranged attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1.


Ferocious Strike: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit with 9” have [Sustained Hits 1].


Friendly Logan Grimnar units have the following ability:


Howling Onslaught: (Once per battle, per army) In your command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly Adeptus Astartes Monster/Vehicle units benefit from the Master of Wolves rule until the start of your next command phase.


Restrictions: Your army can include Space Wolves units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Adaptive Defence
rules.description:
▪ While a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is within a terrain area, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1.
▪ Friendly Adeptus Astartes units are entrenched while all of the following apply:
  ▪ That unit is within a terrain area.
  ▪ That unit was not set up this turn.
  ▪ No model in that unit moved more than 3" this turn.
▪ Friendly Darnath Lysander/Tor Garadon units have the following ability:
  Defensive Mastery: At the start of each phase, this unit is entrenched.


Darnath Lysander's/Tor Garadon's unit is always entrenched, regardless of the conditions listed above.


Restrictions: Your army can include Imperial Fists units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Faith-Fuelled Resolve
rules.description:
In the Fight phase, if a friendly Sword Brethren Squad unit is within range of an objective, that unit's melee attacks have +1A


Restrictions: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Wrath of Angels
rules.description:
The tactical doctrine is active for Sanguinary Guard units in addition to any other combat doctrine.

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Sanguinius' Fury
rules.description:
Friendly DEATH COMPANY units have the following:
- At the start of each phase, the assault doctrine is active for this unit.
- The devastator/tactical doctrine cannot be active for this unit.

*This means that, regardless of any other rules, Death Company units can never have an active doctrine other than the assault doctrine.*

Restrictions: Your army can include Blood Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Black-winged Vigilance
rules.description:
Friendly Ravenwing Fly units' ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER].


Restrictions: Your army can include Dark Angels units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.


Friendly Outrider squad units have Battleline.

rules.name: Assault Mastery
rules.description: You can select the assault doctrine one additional time per battle

rules.name: Tactical Mastery
rules.description: You can select the Tactical Doctrine one additional time.

rules.name: Devastator Mastery
rules.description: You can select the devastator doctrine one additional time per battle.

rules.name: Death Blow
rules.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls

rules.name: Wrath of the Chapter
rules.description: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

rules.name: Codex Fire-Patterns
rules.description: Friendly Tacticus units [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack's maximum range.

rules.name: Shadow Masters
rules.description:
When a Phobos or Scout Squad unit has shot:
▪ Those attacks do not prevent that unit from being hidden
▪ Or: That unit can make a normal move of up to D6". That unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Vanguard Ambushers
rules.description: At the end of your Movement phase, if a friendly Phobos unit is hidden, that unit’s attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Walking Fortress
rules.description:
In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, that unit's ranged attacks:
▪ Do not have [Heavy] 
▪ Have +1 to hit rolls

rules.name: Indomitable Defence
rules.description: While a friendly Gravis unit is within range of an objective, attacks that target that unit with a S greater than that unit's T have -1 to wound rolls

rules.name: Enduring Vengeance
rules.description: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Dreadnought units can re-roll hit rolls of 1

rules.name: Combined Deployment
rules.description:
In your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Transport unit has shot, you can select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is assailed until the end of the turn. 
▪ While a unit is assailed, when an Adeptus Astartes unit that disembarked this turn targets that unit, those attacks have [Sustained Hits 1]

rules.name: New Rule
rules.description:
Each time a friendly Crusader Squad unit makes a surge move, instead of selecting a surge target, you can select the closest objective to that unit. When that unit makes that surge move, each model in that unit must end that surge move as close as possible to that objective instead. 


Restrictions: Your army can include BLACK TEMPLARS units, but it cannot include any ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.

rules.name: Templar Vows
rules.description:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select on Vow listed below. That Vow is active for friendly Adeptus Astartes units until the end of the battle. 


Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch: This unit's melee attacks that target a Psyker unit:

▪ Have [Precision]
▪ Have [Lance]


Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds: Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit's S have the +1 to wound rolls. 


Uphold the Honour of the Emperor: Friendly Infantry units have:
▪ At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured. 
▪ When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start and action.

rules.name: New Rule
rules.description:
Each time a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot or selected to fight apply one of the following when resolving those attacks:


▪ If that unit is within 6" of a friendly Cannok Var/Iron Father Feirros unit you can:
  ▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
  ▪ Re-roll one wound roll.
  ▪ Re-roll one damage roll.
▪ Otherwise you can:
  ▪ Re-roll one hit roll.
  ▪ Or: Re-roll one wound roll.
  ▪ Or: Re-roll one damage roll.

modifiers.value: This detachment is not ready yet. It requires a lot of extra work and is in progress. Please do not report it missing as a bug report.

rules.name: Lies And Obfuscation (Alpha Legion army rule)
rules.description: Nothing about their position is ever quite where it seems. Each time the range from an enemy model to a friendly Alpha Legion model is measured for the purposes of a ranged attack, a Charge move, or a Reaction, treat that range as being 2" greater than it actually is.

rules.name: Smoke And Mirrors
rules.description:
Once per battle, when an enemy unit shoots a friendly Alpha Legion unit that includes an attached Character model, you can select that unit: until that attack is resolved, wounds from that attack must be allocated to non-Character models in that unit while any remain.

Alpha Legion (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: I Am Alpharius (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before an enemy Character unit is chosen to fight. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit fights last in the Fight phase this turn, even if it has an ability that would let it fight first.

rules.name: Stratagem: Forge Anew (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Alpha Legion unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit is not Battle-shocked while it is below its Starting Strength.

rules.name: Stratagem: Sever The Head (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Alpha Legion unit destroys an enemy Character unit. **Target:** Your army. **Effect:** You gain 1 Command Point. This Stratagem can only be used once per battle.

rules.name: Stratagem: Merciless Retaliation (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Alpha Legion unit is destroyed. **Target:** The enemy unit that destroyed it. **Effect:** That enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hydra'S Bite (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Charge phase, just after a friendly Alpha Legion unit ends a Charge move. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit's melee weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Salvage The Fallen (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Alpha Legion Vehicle unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Encarmine Fury (Blood Angels army rule)
rules.description: A Blood Angel who has just closed the distance hits harder than the plan called for. Each time a friendly Blood Angels unit fights, if it made a Charge move this turn, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

rules.name: Wrath Of Angels
rules.description:
Shooting at the sons of Sanguinius from a distance only shortens the distance they have to close. Once per battle, after an enemy unit shoots a friendly Blood Angels unit, if that Blood Angels unit was not destroyed, you can select it to use this Detachment Rule. If you do, it can make a Normal Move of up to 6", moving as close as possible to the enemy unit that shot it (it cannot be moved within Engagement Range of any enemy units as a result of this move). If, after this move, that Blood Angels unit is within 6" of the enemy unit that shot it, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.

Blood Angels (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Thrall Of The Red Thirst (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Blood Angels Character unit fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that unit's melee weapons, but that unit cannot benefit from any other friendly unit's aura abilities this phase.

rules.name: Stratagem: Descent Of Angels (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Movement phase. **Target:** One friendly Blood Angels unit with the [DEEP STRIKE] ability that is set up on the battlefield this phase. **Effect:** That unit is eligible to declare a charge this turn.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Red Thirst (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Blood Angels unit destroys the last model in an enemy unit. **Target:** That Blood Angels unit. **Effect:** That unit can fight again, but only if it has not already fought twice this phase.

rules.name: Stratagem: Grief Unending (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Any phase, just after a friendly Blood Angels Character model is destroyed. **Target:** Friendly Blood Angels units within 6" of that model. **Effect:** Until the end of the battle, each time a targeted unit fights, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit's melee weapons.

rules.name: Stratagem: Mercy Of The Angel (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Blood Angels unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 6, that model is not destroyed and instead is returned to the unit with 1 wound remaining.

rules.name: Stratagem: Crimson Reckoning (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Blood Angels unit that is below its Starting Strength fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

selectionEntries.name: Dark Angels (HH): Vengeance of the First Legion [NFLB]

rules.name: The Angel Of Death (Dark Angels army rule)
rules.description: Friendly Dark Angels units cannot have their Leadership characteristic modified to be worse than 6+. Each time an ability would inflict a penalty on a friendly Dark Angels unit's Leadership characteristic, that penalty is capped at -1, regardless of the ability's own stated value.

rules.name: Vengeance Of The First Legion
rules.description:
The Order does not settle for the first outcome of a fight if the first outcome was not the right one.

Dark Angels (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Sword Of The Order (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Dark Angels Character model equipped with a melee weapon that has the Sword of the Order trait is selected to fight. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that weapon has the [LETHAL HITS] ability, but subtract 1 from its Attacks characteristic.

rules.name: Stratagem: Duellist'S Discipline (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Dark Angels Character model's melee attack targets an enemy Character model. **Target:** That attack. **Effect:** You can re-roll the Hit roll and the Wound roll for that attack.

rules.name: Stratagem: Silent Vigil (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Dark Angels unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit has the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Order Stands (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** End of any phase, if a friendly Dark Angels unit lost one or more models earlier this phase. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit automatically passes Battle-shock tests until the end of the battle round.

rules.name: Stratagem: Secret Of The Inner Circle (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Start of your opponent's Charge phase. **Target:** One friendly Dark Angels Infantry unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save. If it already has an invulnerable save, use whichever is better.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Oath Unkept (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Dark Angels Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Remorseless Advance (Death Guard army rule)
rules.description: A Death Guard company does not need to choose between moving and shooting straight. Each time a model in a friendly Death Guard unit makes a ranged attack with a weapon that has the [HEAVY] ability, that attack still gains the benefit of [HEAVY] even if the unit made a Normal Move this turn (instead of only if it Remained Stationary).

rules.name: Grim Endurance
rules.description:
Something in Barbaran flesh simply refuses to stop working, long after any reasonable body would have given out. Friendly Death Guard Infantry units have the [FEEL NO PAIN 6+] ability.

Death Guard (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Barbaran Endurance (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after they select a friendly Death Guard Infantry unit (that is not a Vehicle) as the target of a ranged attack. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Remove that unit from Battle-shock if it is currently under that effect. Until the end of the phase, that unit has the [FEEL NO PAIN 5+] ability and automatically passes Battle-shock tests. Use this Stratagem only once per battle.

rules.name: Stratagem: Toughened By The March (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Death Guard unit is selected to fight. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, add 2 to the Toughness characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Stratagem: Chemical Payload (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Death Guard unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, an unmodified Wound roll of 3+ always scores a wound, regardless of the target's Toughness characteristic.

rules.name: Stratagem: Grave Discipline (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** End of any phase, if a friendly Death Guard unit lost one or more models earlier this phase. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit automatically passes Battle-shock tests until the end of the battle round.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Long March (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Movement phase, just before a friendly Death Guard unit moves. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit is treated as not moving through Difficult Terrain for any purpose.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Body Left Behind (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Death Guard Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Flawless Execution (Emperor's Children army rule)
rules.description: A charge is only as good as the strike that ends it, and no Legion in the galaxy lands that strike more cleanly. Each time a friendly Emperor's Children unit that made a Charge move this turn is chosen to fight, that unit has the [FIGHTS FIRST] ability (this does not stack with Core).

rules.name: Perfect Counter
rules.description:
There is no clumsier compliment than a charge that fails to kill you. Once per battle, each time an enemy unit declares a charge that targets a friendly Emperor's Children unit, you can select that Emperor's Children unit to immediately make a Charge move against the charging unit, as if it were your Charge phase (this does not use up your unit's normal Charge move this turn, and the enemy unit's Charge move still proceeds as normal afterwards).

Emperor's Children (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Paragon Of Excellence (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children Character unit is chosen to fight. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's melee weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Nothing Less Than Perfect (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Emperor's Children unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll, but if you do, you must also re-roll a successful Hit roll for that attack.

rules.name: Stratagem: Rapture Of The Kill (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Emperor's Children Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Stratagem: Adoring Audience (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Emperor's Children unit destroys the last model in an enemy unit. **Target:** One other friendly Emperor's Children unit within 6" of that Fight. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit's Leadership characteristic cannot be modified to be worse than 6+.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Substitute For Victory (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Charge phase. **Target:** One friendly Emperor's Children unit. **Effect:** That unit can declare a charge even if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.

rules.name: Stratagem: Exquisite Cruelty (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, when a friendly Emperor's Children unit is chosen to fight. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

rules.name: Fire Discipline (Imperial Fists army rule)
rules.description: No shot is wasted, and no volley is undisciplined. Each time a unit with this ability shoots, if it makes 6 or more attacks with Bolt weapons as part of that Shooting Attack, add 1 to the Hit roll for those attacks.

rules.name: Bastion Of Fire
rules.description:
Nothing crosses open ground in front of an Imperial Fists gun line without being seen, and nothing seen goes unanswered. Once per battle, each time an enemy unit ends a Move within 10" of and visible to a friendly Imperial Fists unit (excluding Vehicles) that has not already shot this turn, you can select that Imperial Fists unit: it can immediately shoot at the enemy unit that just moved, as though it were your Shooting phase. If it does, it cannot be selected to shoot again later this turn.

Imperial Fists (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: A Wall Unyielding (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Imperial Fists Character unit fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time damage is allocated to a model in that unit, that damage is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1 — but that unit does not have the [FIGHTS FIRST] ability this phase, even if it would otherwise.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hold The Line (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of a friendly Imperial Fists unit that Remained Stationary this turn. **Target:** That Imperial Fists unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit has the Benefit of Cover and its melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Ground Surrendered (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a friendly Imperial Fists unit is destroyed. **Target:** That unit's controlling player. **Effect:** Until the end of the battle, once per battle round, when a friendly Imperial Fists unit is set up on the battlefield within your own deployment zone, it can be set up as though it were the start of the battle.

rules.name: Stratagem: Precision Fire (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Imperial Fists unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [PRECISION] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Siege Discipline (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Imperial Fists unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time that unit is targeted by an attack made with a weapon that has the [BLAST] ability, subtract 1 from the number of attacks made by that weapon.

rules.name: Stratagem: Terran Resolve (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Imperial Fists unit destroys the last model in an enemy unit. **Target:** That Imperial Fists unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit's Objective Control characteristic is doubled.

selectionEntries.name: Iron Hands (HH): Spite of the Gorgon [NFLB]

rules.name: The Gorgon'S Scales (Iron Hands army rule)
rules.description: Flesh gives way. What replaces it does not. Each time an attack targets a friendly Iron Hands unit, worsen the Strength characteristic of that attack by 1.

rules.name: Spite Of The Gorgon
rules.description:
Every charge into an Iron Hands line is paid for before it lands. Once per battle, when an enemy unit declares a charge that targets a friendly Iron Hands unit, before Charge moves are made, you can select that Iron Hands unit: it can shoot the charging enemy unit, as though it were your Shooting phase. Until that attack is resolved, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Iron Hands (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Legion Of One (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Iron Hands Character unit fights, or Shooting phase, just before it shoots. **Target:** That unit, if it is not within 6" of any other friendly unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Hit rolls for that unit's attacks.

rules.name: Stratagem: Replace The Weak (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Any phase, just after a model in a friendly Iron Hands unit is destroyed. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit's Toughness characteristic is increased by 1.

rules.name: Stratagem: Grim Determination (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Iron Hands unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit is not Battle-shocked while it is below its Starting Strength.

rules.name: Stratagem: Merciless Retaliation (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Iron Hands unit is destroyed. **Target:** The enemy unit that destroyed it. **Effect:** That enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: Forge Anew (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Iron Hands Vehicle unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time that unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, it can shoot or fight one more time.

rules.name: Stratagem: Cold Logic (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Iron Hands unit that Remained Stationary this turn is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

rules.name: The Bitter End (Iron Warriors army rule)
rules.description: A company that has survived every siege it was ever sent to does not break because the enemy wants it to. Each time a friendly Iron Warriors unit takes a Battle-shock test, ignore any modifiers that would worsen that test.

rules.name: Bitter Fury
rules.description:
Every gun in an Iron Warriors company keeps firing for exactly as long as there is a hand left to hold it. Once per battle, after a friendly Iron Warriors unit (excluding Vehicles) is selected as the target of a ranged attack and that attack has been resolved, that unit can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, using its characteristics as they were before that attack was resolved (including any models destroyed by it). Ranged weapons used this way have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Iron Warriors (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Spiteful Demise (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Iron Warriors Character model is destroyed. **Target:** The enemy model that destroyed it. **Effect:** That enemy model's unit suffers 2 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: Grind Them Down (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Iron Warriors unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack that targets a unit within half range of that weapon, an unmodified Wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 additional mortal wound on the target after all other damage has been resolved.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hold The Line (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Charge phase. **Target:** One friendly Iron Warriors unit that is within your own deployment zone. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save. If it already has an invulnerable save, use whichever is better.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Retreat (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** End of any phase, if a friendly Iron Warriors unit lost one or more models earlier this phase. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit automatically passes Battle-shock tests until the end of the battle round.

rules.name: Stratagem: Siege Engineers (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Iron Warriors Vehicle unit. **Effect:** That unit regains up to D3 lost wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Wall Does Not Fall (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Iron Warriors Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

selectionEntries.name: Night Lords (HH): Better Part of Valour [NFLB]

rules.name: A Talent For Murder (Night Lords army rule)
rules.description: The VIII Legion was built for one purpose: to find the weakness terror leaves behind, and open it wider. Each time a model in a friendly Night Lords unit makes a melee attack that targets a Battle-shocked unit, add 1 to the Hit roll.

rules.name: Better Part Of Valour
rules.description:
No Night Lords captain ever mistook cowardice for the tactical retreat, and no Night Lords captain was ever ashamed to order one. Each time an enemy unit declares a charge that targets a friendly Night Lords unit, you can select that Night Lords unit to immediately make a Fall Back move, as if it were your Movement phase. If you do, that Night Lords unit is removed as an eligible target of that Charge move (any other targets of the same Charge move are unaffected), and that Night Lords unit does not suffer any of the normal penalties for having Fallen Back this turn.

Night Lords (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Nostraman Courage (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, after an enemy unit selects a friendly Night Lords Character model as the target of one or more of its attacks. **Target:** That Character model's unit. **Effect:** You can select a different, non-Character model in that unit to be allocated those attacks instead, provided that model is within Engagement Range of the attacking model.

rules.name: Stratagem: First To The Kill (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Charge phase. **Target:** One friendly Night Lords unit that made a Charge move this phase. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit has the [FIGHTS FIRST] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Merciless Spite (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Night Lords Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hunt The Broken (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your opponent's Command phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. **Target:** One friendly Night Lords unit within 12" of that enemy unit. **Effect:** Until the start of your next turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that Night Lords unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability when targeting that enemy unit.

rules.name: Stratagem: Vanish Into The Dark (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a friendly Night Lords unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack. **Target:** That Night Lords unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Benefit of Cover, and any ability that ignores the Benefit of Cover does not apply to it.

rules.name: Stratagem: Decapitation Strike (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, when a friendly Night Lords unit is chosen to fight. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's melee weapons have the [PRECISION] ability.

rules.name: Shadow Walkers (Raven Guard army rule)
rules.description: By the time the shot lands, they were never really there. Each time a ranged attack targets a friendly Raven Guard unit from a distance of 18" or greater, subtract 1 from that attack's Hit roll.

rules.name: Shadow Veil
rules.description:
Once per battle, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Raven Guard unit (excluding Vehicles) with a ranged attack, before that attack is resolved, you can select that unit: it can make a Normal Move of up to its Movement characteristic, and until the end of the phase, subtract 1 from Hit rolls for attacks that target it. If this movement takes that unit out of range or Line of Sight of every model in the attacking unit, the attacking unit cannot select a new target this phase.

Raven Guard (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Decapitation Strike (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Raven Guard Character model fights. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** That model makes a single melee attack first, resolved before its other attacks. If that attack scores a wound, this model can then make its remaining attacks as normal. If it does not, this model makes no further attacks this phase.

rules.name: Stratagem: Forge Anew (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Raven Guard unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit is not Battle-shocked while it is below its Starting Strength.

rules.name: Stratagem: Ghosts In The Dark (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Movement phase, just before a friendly Raven Guard unit is selected to move. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit can move across models and terrain features as if they were not there.

rules.name: Stratagem: Merciless Retaliation (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Raven Guard unit is destroyed. **Target:** The enemy unit that destroyed it. **Effect:** That enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: Strike From Shadow (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Charge phase. **Target:** One friendly Raven Guard unit that made a Charge move this phase. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit's melee weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Salvage The Fallen (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Raven Guard Vehicle unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Promethean Endurance & Blood Of Fire (Salamanders army rule)
rules.description: The forge tempers what fire cannot break. Each time an attack targets a friendly Salamanders unit, that attack's Wound roll cannot succeed on an unmodified roll of 1 or 2. In addition, friendly Salamanders units are unaffected by the Battle-shock tests triggered by attacks made by Flamer-type weapons.

rules.name: Selfless Burden
rules.description:
There is always one more of them willing to be the wall. Once per battle, when an enemy unit declares a charge that targets a friendly Salamanders unit (excluding Vehicles), you can select that unit: until the end of the Fight phase, improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit by 1, and add 1 to the Attacks and Strength characteristics of those weapons. Then, for each model in that unit that fights this phase, roll one D6: on a 1, that model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

Salamanders (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Duty Is Sacrifice (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase or Shooting phase, just before a friendly Salamanders Character model is chosen to fight or shoot. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** Select a number from 1-3. That model suffers that many mortal wounds. Until the end of the phase, add that number to Hit rolls for that model's attacks.

rules.name: Stratagem: Forge Anew (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Salamanders unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit is not Battle-shocked while it is below its Starting Strength.

rules.name: Stratagem: Cleansing Flame (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just before a friendly Salamanders unit shoots. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit that have the [TORRENT] ability have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Merciless Retaliation (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Salamanders unit is destroyed. **Target:** The enemy unit that destroyed it. **Effect:** That enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: Grim Determination (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Salamanders unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, an unmodified Wound roll of 1 or 2 still fails, but a Critical Wound is scored on an unmodified Wound roll of 5+ (instead of 6+).

rules.name: Stratagem: Salvage The Fallen (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Salamanders Vehicle unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability.

selectionEntries.name: Sons of Horus (HH): Masters of the Legion [NFLB]

rules.name: Death Dealers (Sons of Horus army rule)
rules.description: The Sons of Horus never fire a wasted shot, and never a rushed one either. Each time a model in a friendly Sons of Horus unit makes a ranged attack with a weapon that has the [RAPID FIRE X] or [HEAVY] ability, that attack does not lose the benefit of that ability, even if the unit Advanced this turn.

rules.name: Masters Of The Legion
rules.description:
Every commander in this Legion was placed there personally by the Warmaster, and every one of them fights with his authority behind them. Each time a friendly Sons of Horus unit that is within 6" of a friendly Sons of Horus Character model is selected to fight, melee weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

Sons of Horus (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Merciless Strike (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Sons of Horus Character model is selected to fight. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time a melee attack is made with a weapon equipped by that model, an unmodified Wound roll of 4+ always scores a wound, regardless of the target's Toughness characteristic.

rules.name: Stratagem: Warrior Pride (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Charge phase, just after an enemy unit ends a Charge move within Engagement Range of a friendly Sons of Horus unit. **Target:** That friendly unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit has the [FIGHTS FIRST] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: The First To Strike (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Sons of Horus unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack that targets the closest eligible enemy unit, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 scores 1 additional hit.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Retreat (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** End of any phase, if a friendly Sons of Horus unit lost one or more models earlier this phase. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit automatically passes Battle-shock tests until the end of the battle round.

rules.name: Stratagem: Cthonian Gambit (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Sons of Horus unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time that unit Advances, it can move as if it had rolled a 6 on the Advance roll.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Warmaster Demands It (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Sons of Horus Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: The Hunter'S Strike (Space Wolves army rule)
rules.description: The pack does not wait for the horn before it moves. Each time a unit with this ability is set up on the battlefield from Strategic Reserves or as part of a Deep Strike ability, it can be set up as though the relevant minimum distance from enemy models were 2" less than normal (to a minimum of 3").

rules.name: Bestial Savagery
rules.description:
Wound them, and they only close the distance faster. Once per battle, each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot a friendly Space Wolves unit, after that attack has been resolved, if that Space Wolves unit was not destroyed you can select it to use this Detachment Rule. If you do, until the end of the phase that unit has the [FEEL NO PAIN 5+] ability, and it can then make a Normal Move of up to 6", to as close as possible to the closest enemy unit (it cannot be moved within Engagement Range of any enemy units as a result of this move). If, after this move, that Space Wolves unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, in your following Charge phase it can be selected to declare a charge against those units without needing to make a Charge move or Charge roll.

Space Wolves (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: A Saga Woven Of Glory (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Space Wolves Character unit destroys the last model in an enemy unit. **Target:** That Character's unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the Fight phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in that unit.

rules.name: Stratagem: Rush The Line (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Movement phase. **Target:** One friendly Space Wolves unit. **Effect:** That unit is eligible to declare a charge this turn even though it Advanced.

rules.name: Stratagem: Runic Ward (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Any phase, just after a friendly Space Wolves Psyker unit is selected as the target of an attack, a Psychic Action, or a Stratagem used by your opponent. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Roll one D6, adding 1 to the result if that unit is within 6" of a friendly Space Wolves Caster of Runes model: on a 4+, that attack, Psychic Action, or Stratagem has no effect.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Prey Escapes (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Space Wolves Character unit fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's melee weapons have the [LETHAL HITS] ability, and that unit cannot be destroyed as a result of a Fall Back or similar effect until it has made all of its attacks.

rules.name: Stratagem: Saga Of The Wulfen (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Space Wolves unit below its Starting Strength. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified Hit roll of 6 automatically wounds the target, regardless of that attack's Strength and the target's Toughness characteristics.

rules.name: Stratagem: Feast Of The Fallen (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Space Wolves unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time a model in that unit is destroyed, roll one D6: on a 5+, that unit's Objective Control characteristic is increased by 1 until the end of the battle round.

selectionEntries.name: Thousand Sons (HH): Fortress of the Mind [NFLB]

rules.name: Cult Arcana (Thousand Sons army rule)
rules.description: Every warrior of the Fifteenth Legion is touched by the warp, whether they have been tested for it yet or not. All friendly Thousand Sons Infantry models have the [PSYKER] ability.

rules.name: Fortress Of The Mind
rules.description:
A mind trained on Prospero can turn aside a bolt round the same way it turns aside a lesser sorcerer's hex. Once per battle, when a friendly Thousand Sons unit (excluding Vehicles) is selected as the target of a ranged attack, you can activate this rule. If you do, roll one D6: on a 4+, that unit has a 3+ invulnerable save against that attack; on a 1-3, that unit has a 5+ invulnerable save against that attack instead, and after the attack is resolved, that unit and the attacking unit each suffer 1 mortal wound.

Thousand Sons (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Prophetic Duellist (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Thousand Sons Character model is selected to fight. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each unmodified Hit roll of 4+ made for that model's attacks is treated as a Critical Hit.

rules.name: Stratagem: ætheric Shield (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a friendly Thousand Sons unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit has the Benefit of Cover.

rules.name: Stratagem: Rune Of Warding (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time that unit would suffer a mortal wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, that mortal wound is not suffered.

rules.name: Stratagem: No Retreat (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** End of any phase, if a friendly Thousand Sons unit lost one or more models earlier this phase. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit automatically passes Battle-shock tests until the end of the battle round.

rules.name: Stratagem: Corvidae Foresight (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** After both players have deployed their armies, before the first turn begins. **Target:** N/A. **Effect:** You can redeploy up to one friendly Thousand Sons unit, following the normal rules for deployment.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Rite Is Unbroken (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Thousand Sons Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Tactical Flexibility (Ultramarines army rule)
rules.description: No Ultramarines commander wastes resources on a plan that has already worked. Once per battle round, the first time you use a Stratagem that targets a friendly Ultramarines unit, you can subtract 1CP from that Stratagem's cost, to a minimum of 0CP.

rules.name: Retribution Strike
rules.description:
A shot fired at one company is a shot answered by another. Once per battle, each time an enemy unit shoots a friendly Ultramarines unit, you can select a different friendly Ultramarines unit that has not been selected to shoot this phase, is within range of and has visibility to the enemy unit that made that attack, and is entirely composed of Ultramarines models: that unit can be selected to shoot the attacking enemy unit immediately, as though it were your Shooting phase.

Ultramarines (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Aegis Of Wisdom (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just before a friendly Ultramarines Character unit fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, add 1 to that unit's Attacks characteristic for each other friendly Ultramarines Character unit on the battlefield, to a maximum of +3.

rules.name: Stratagem: By The Book (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Ultramarines unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time that unit is Battle-shocked, at the start of your next Command phase it automatically recovers from Battle-shock.

rules.name: Stratagem: Disciplined Fire (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly Ultramarines unit that Remained Stationary this turn is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged weapons equipped by models in that unit have the [SUSTAINED HITS 1] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Doctrines Of War (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Ultramarines unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit's Objective Control characteristic is increased by 1.

rules.name: Stratagem: Counter-Offensive (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Ultramarines unit is destroyed. **Target:** The enemy unit that destroyed it. **Effect:** That enemy unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Ultima Founding (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Ultramarines Infantry unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit can perform actions and use its Objective Control characteristic to control objectives even while Battle-shocked.

rules.name: Swift Of Action (White Scars army rule)
rules.description: No enemy plans for a Legion that can simply choose to be somewhere else, faster than the plan accounted for. Each time a friendly White Scars unit is selected to move in the Movement phase, you can add 2" to its Move characteristic for that move.

rules.name: Chasing The Wind
rules.description:
The White Scars do not wait to see where the enemy goes — they are already moving to meet them there. Each time an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance, or Fall Back move within 12" and visible to a friendly White Scars unit that has not moved this phase, that White Scars unit can immediately make a Normal Move of up to its Movement characteristic. A unit that moves this way cannot declare a charge later this turn.

White Scars (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Path Of The Warrior (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, when a friendly White Scars unit is chosen to fight. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, you can re-roll the Hit roll.

rules.name: Stratagem: Hit And Away (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly White Scars unit fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** That unit can immediately make a Normal Move of up to 3", even though it is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units. Each time that unit's Move takes it out of Engagement Range of all enemy units, it does not count as having Fallen Back this turn.

rules.name: Stratagem: Circling The Prey (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Shooting phase, just after a friendly White Scars unit is selected to shoot. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, ranged attacks made by that unit do not suffer the penalty to their Hit roll for the target having the Benefit of Cover.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Hunt Never Ends (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly White Scars Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Stratagem: Scatter To The Wind (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after a friendly White Scars unit is selected as the target of a ranged attack. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1 (to a minimum of 0), making it less effective against this unit's saves.

rules.name: Stratagem: Fall Upon Them (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Charge phase. **Target:** One friendly White Scars unit that made a Charge move this phase. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, that unit's melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

rules.name: Zealotry Of The Faithful (Word Bearers army rule)
rules.description: Faith does not care whether the guns are still firing. Each time a friendly Word Bearers unit is Battle-shocked, that unit's Objective Control characteristic is not reduced to 0.

rules.name: Glorious Martyrdom
rules.description:
Every company keeps at least one believer willing to stand in the way of the bullet meant for someone else. Once per battle, each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot a friendly Word Bearers unit, before any Hit rolls are made, you can select one model in that Word Bearers unit: until that attack has been fully resolved, all wounds allocated by that attack must be allocated to the selected model.

Word Bearers (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Beseech The Gods (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, before a friendly Word Bearers Character unit fights. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Roll one D6: on a 4+, until the end of the phase, add 1 to that model's Strength and Attacks characteristics. On a 1-3, that model suffers 1 mortal wound.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Word Made Flesh (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Word Bearers unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, each time that unit takes a Battle-shock test, that test is automatically passed.

rules.name: Stratagem: A Death That Serves (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Word Bearers Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.

rules.name: Stratagem: Rite Of Defilement (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your opponent's Command phase, just after an enemy unit fails a Battle-shock test. **Target:** One friendly Word Bearers unit within 12" of that enemy unit. **Effect:** Until the start of your next turn, ranged weapons equipped by models in that Word Bearers unit have the [LETHAL HITS] ability when targeting that enemy unit.

rules.name: Stratagem: Bound In Faith (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly Word Bearers Daemon unit. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, that unit has a 4+ invulnerable save. If it already has an invulnerable save, use whichever is better.

rules.name: Stratagem: The Cathedral Of Blood (2CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly Word Bearers unit destroys the last model in an enemy unit. **Target:** That Word Bearers unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit's melee weapons have the [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] ability.

selectionEntries.name: World Eaters (HH): Lost to the Nails [NFLB]

rules.name: Violence Incarnate (World Eaters army rule)
rules.description: The World Eaters need no tactical genius to fight well — only a target within reach. Each time a model in a friendly World Eaters unit makes a melee attack on a turn in which that unit made a Charge move, add 1 to that attack's Attacks characteristic.

rules.name: Lost To The Nails
rules.description:
When the Legion's discipline fails, the Nails do not. Each time a friendly World Eaters unit is selected to take a Battle-shock test, you can choose for that unit to become Lost to the Nails instead of taking that test. While a unit is Lost to the Nails:

A unit stops being Lost to the Nails at the start of any Charge phase in which no enemy unit is within 12" of it.

World Eaters (HH) units and Primarch can only be included while using this detachment; generic Legiones Astartes (HH) units need any Horus Heresy Legion detachment.

rules.name: Stratagem: Violent Overkill (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly World Eaters Character model's melee attack destroys the last model in the unit it targeted. **Target:** That Character model. **Effect:** That model can make one additional melee attack with the same weapon, which must target a different enemy unit within Engagement Range.

rules.name: Stratagem: Brutal Dismemberment (1CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly World Eaters Character model's melee attack destroys an enemy Character model. **Target:** N/A. **Effect:** If the destroyed model was your opponent's Warlord, you immediately gain 1 Command Point.

rules.name: Stratagem: Brutal Tide (2CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your opponent's Shooting phase, just after they select a friendly World Eaters Infantry unit as the target of a ranged attack. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the phase, your unit has the [FEEL NO PAIN 6+] ability. If it is not destroyed, at the end of the phase it can declare a charge against the unit that targeted it, resolved immediately as if it were your Charge phase. Use this Stratagem only once per battle.

rules.name: Stratagem: Feral Momentum (1CP)
rules.description: Battle Tactic. **When:** Your Charge phase, just after a friendly World Eaters unit that is Lost to the Nails finishes a Charge move. **Target:** That unit. **Effect:** Until the end of the turn, that unit has the [FIGHTS FIRST] ability.

rules.name: Stratagem: Skulls For The Skull Throne (1CP)
rules.description: Strategic Ploy. **When:** Your Command phase. **Target:** One friendly World Eaters unit that is within range of an objective marker. **Effect:** Until your next Command phase, add 1 to the Wound roll for melee attacks made by models in that unit.

rules.name: Stratagem: Unstoppable Butchery (2CP)
rules.description: Epic Deed. **When:** Fight phase, just after a friendly World Eaters Character model is destroyed, before it is removed from play. **Target:** That model. **Effect:** If that model has not already fought this phase, it can fight once, using its normal characteristics, before being removed as a casualty.
